column1: # Side profiles for four engineering vehicles whose photographs did not show
# The BMR-3M was the worst: a close crop of a mine plough and a length of
# track, with no hull in frame at all. BREM-1 was head-on, so the crane jib
# along the side — its first recognition cue — was invisible. GMZ-3 was a
# front three-quarter crowded by the vehicle parked beside it. BAT-2 was
# cropped at both ends, showing the blade and nothing else.
# All four now show the whole vehicle from the side or near side, which is
# what the cues on these cards describe.
